codes.means: the name does not resolve to a place inside people/
codes.fix: rename the folder to a lowercase slug of letters, digits and dashes

codes.means: both <slug>.md and <slug>/friend.md exist for one person
codes.fix: merge the flat file into the folder record and delete the flat one

codes.means: a <slug>.md record in a workspace that uses person folders
a required header key is absent
codes.fix: add the listed keys to the header

codes.means: a required header key is present but empty
the record names no standard, the unversioned URL written before versions, or another kind's
the record names a friend standard version this package does not implement
codes.fix: upgrade @supersuit/friend-md to a version that implements it, or correct the record's standard:

codes.means: the header id differs from the folder name
codes.fix: make id equal the folder name, or rename the folder

codes.means: the record is over its size limit (8192 bytes, 1024 when blocked), the standard: line not counted
codes.fix: move detail into story.md, quotes.md or log/

codes.means: the Now section has more than 10 nonblank lines
codes.fix: trim Now to what is true now; move the rest to log/ or story.md

codes.means: circle is not one of inner, close, active, known, past, blocked
codes.fix: set circle to one of the six values

codes.means: a relationship facet is not in the vocabulary or the workspace's people/README.md Facets section
codes.fix: use a listed facet, or declare it under ## Facets in people/README.md

codes.means: a log bullet is not `- YYYY-MM[-DD] · text [source]`, `(my read)` or `(said by X)`
codes.fix: rewrite the line in the log shape

codes.means: a file in the person folder that the format does not define
codes.fix: move it into story.md, media.md or a known folder, or delete it

codes.means: the record could not be read
codes.fix: check the file's permissions and encoding
